nl_Literal_translation_en: For the next 5 seconds, the throttle command shall remain below 30 percent.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在接下来的 5 秒内，油门指令应始终低于 30%。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the 5-second traction-control interval, the commanded throttle shall continuously remain below 30 percent.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在 5 秒的牵引力控制区间内，油门指令应持续保持在 30% 以下。
